name: MCP Apps
description: Builds interactive UIs like charts, forms and dashboards that MCP tools render inline in Claude, ChatGPT and VS Code, with the official MCP Apps SDK, for MCP server developers.

skills.name: Tool UI Resources
skills.description: Declares ui:// HTML resources on MCP tools so hosts render them in a sandboxed iframe and pass tool data to the view.

skills.name: Create an MCP App
skills.description: Scaffolds a new MCP App with an interactive UI from scratch when you ask your coding agent to create one.

skills.name: Migrate an OpenAI App
skills.description: Converts an existing OpenAI Apps SDK app to MCP Apps so its interface renders in any compliant MCP host.

skills.name: Add UI to an MCP Server
skills.description: Adds interactive UI to the tools of an existing MCP server, so results show as views instead of plain text.

skills.name: Convert a Web App
skills.description: Turns an existing web app into a hybrid web and MCP App that also renders inline inside MCP chat clients.
